extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking literary representation; writers submitting queries/manuscripts to literary agents
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for querying and submitting manuscripts to the literary agency Writers House, including verifying agent-specific requirements, required manuscript state, permissible genres, and agency submission policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify query and/or submission guidelines per agent/agency
rubrics_metrics.description: The Market List recommends you verify the query and/or submission guidelines for each literary agent and literary agency before sending a query or submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check each agent's or the agency's own published guidelines rather than relying solely on third-party summaries; follow any agent-specific requirements for query format, materials requested, and submission method.

rubrics_metrics.name: Most agencies require a completed manuscript prior to queries/submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Most agencies require a completed manuscript prior to queries or submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit partial manuscripts or proposals unless the agent/agency explicitly permits it; ensure your manuscript is fully polished and complete when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify agency requirements for new or unpublished writers and areas of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Review and verify the agency requirements for working with new or unpublished writers as well as their specific areas of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm whether the agency represents debut authors, what genres/subjects each agent handles, and any other qualification thresholds (e.g., prior publication, platform) before querying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide community feedback if you have recent submission experience
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have recently submitted to Writers House or have experience with a specific agent, please submit a comment below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Market List comment functionality to report submission outcomes or agent responsiveness to help other writers; this is a suggested community practice rather than a submission requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hard copy queries: one agent at a time within the agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers House requests hard copy queries to only one agent within the agency at a time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send the same physical query simultaneously to multiple agents at Writers House; if you send hard copy materials, choose a single agent within the agency and wait for a response before querying another agent there.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market types represented
rubrics_metrics.description: Market Types Represented: Juvenile, Fiction, Non-fiction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these market-type labels to determine whether your work falls within the agency's represented categories; manuscripts outside these primary types may be a poor fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres and subjects accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepts: Adventure, animals, art, autobiography, biography, business, cartoons, child guidance, cooking, crime, decorating, detective, diet/nutrition, economics, erotica, ethnic, family saga, fantasy, feminist, film, food, gay, health, historical fiction, history, humor, interior design, juvenile fiction and non-fiction, literary fiction, mainstream fiction, medicine, military, money, music, mystery, New Age, occult, parenting, picture books, psychology, regional, romance, satire, science, self-help, spiritual, sports, technology, theater, thriller, translation, true crime, war, Westerns, women's fiction, women's issues, women's studies, young adult.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare your manuscript's genre/subject to this list to assess fit; the extensive list indicates the agency represents a wide range but you should still target the specific agent within the agency who handles your genre.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary contacts / agent list
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary Contacts: Amy Berkower, Albert Zuckerman, Susan Cohen, Dan Conaway, Susan Ginsburg, Leigh Feldman, Merrilee Heifetz, Daniel Lazar, Simon Lipskar, Jodi Reamer, Michele Rubin, Robin Rue, Rebecca Sherman, Stephen Barr, Brianne Johnson, Beth Miller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address queries to a specific agent from the list when possible; research each named agent's specialties and submission preferences before sending materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission address and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission Address: 21 West 26th Street, New York NY 10010. Phone: (212) 685-2400. Fax: (212) 685-1781. Web Address: www.writershouse.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided postal address, phone, fax, and website contact details for submissions or to find the agency's complete submission guidelines; verify current contact info on the agency's official website before sending materials.
